# Trademark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Trademark>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

The reified trademark right over a mark — binding the mark, its holder, the registration number and the ™/®/status value. Aligned (by reference) to [schema:Brand](https://schema.org/Brand), the WIPO trademark vocabulary and Wikidata.
